title: Career Table Showdowns column displays W-D-L instead of showdown count
steps: Use a record of 2 showdown wins, 1 draw and 0 losses.
Open Career Statistics or Trophy Room and read the Career Table.
expected: The column headed Showdowns shows 3, or the heading clearly says it is a Showdown W-D-L record.
actual: The heading says Showdowns, but the row prints 2-1-0 from showdownWins, showdownDraws and showdownLosses.
root_cause: createCareerStandingsTable labels the third column Showdowns while filling it with the three-part showdown W-D-L record.
checked_against: js/trophyRoom.js createManagerCabinet, which separately shows W-D-L and the total showdown count in plain text
js/statistics.js career summary, which separately reports the completed-showdown total

fix.change: Make the Career Table heading and value agree. Prefer showing manager.showdowns under Showdowns; if the W-D-L record is intended, rename the heading to Showdown W-D-L.

assumptions: The Career Table heading Showdowns is intended to mean the number of completed showdowns, consistent with the surrounding career summary.
